factsSkipped.note: Checked miopostopizza.com homepage and /menu/dinner; no pizza is labeled signature, most popular, or famous, only 'Fig and Prosciutto' flagged as a seasonal special.

Checked anticosopranos.com homepage, /menu, and the linked order.menudrive.com storefront; none list pizza prices or name a signature/most popular pie, and the items sit behind an unreadable category page.

Checked steviesfamous.com and tried order.steviesfamous.com and order.toasttab.com ordering pages, which returned 403/loading errors; could not confirm a whole-pie price from a page I could actually open.
Checked goodshapepizza.com and The Infatuation's review; neither gives an opening year, only that it began as a mobile pop-up before settling at Jupiter Bar in Belltown.
Checked Curiocity coverage plus Fabulous Washington and Axios (both 403); reviewers single out the Carbonara and El Pastor as standouts but no page names one pizza as signature or most popular.

Checked johnnymos.com (About page 404), myedmondsnews.com (403) and enprimeurclub.com; no opening date found, and no single pizza is named signature, only separate 'Johnny's Pick' (NY thin crust) and 'Mo's Pick' (Chicago thick crust).
Checked myfrienddereks.com and Gayot; neither states an opening year, only that the business began as a pop-up before opening its Tangletown brick-and-mortar.

Checked pizzapivegan.com (About page 404) and VegNews coverage; the October 2015 VegNews article says the business was 'open for 13 years' at that point but gives no explicit founding year, and no pizza is named a signature or most popular dish.
Checked pulcinellapizza.com (unreachable/403) and South Seattle Emerald coverage; no opening year is given, only that owner Vince Mottola revamped the former Lakeside Tavern space in that building.
Checked eymanspizza.com (About page 403/404) and web coverage; found no opening year and no pizza named as signature or most popular.
Checked coltivasea.com and a 2018 Seattleite review; coverage praises both the Margherita and the Autunno but names neither as a single signature pizza.
